m_dialogEntries.m_dialog: Wizard, did you recover the Death Spiral? Thank the Sands! Wait. That Egg... It has an air of rottenness about it. Tell me more.
Hmm. I see. Good work. I will destroy the Death Spiral immediately. But I cannot in good conscience destroy this Egg. Will you take it?
Excellent. Thank you. But do be careful if you return to Mirage with it. Who knows how a Mother Ghoulture would react to an actual Ghulture Egg!
Thank you for coming, Wizard. I have a sensitive matter which I believe you are uniquely qualified to help with.
A rogue Initiate Necromancer named Druj stole a book entitled, The Death Spiral, which contains outlawed pet hatching techniques.
I was ordered to destroy the Death Spiral years ago, but I chose instead to hide it here in my Office under lock and key.
I know not how Druj learned of the book's existence, let alone how he was able to steal it, but such is the situation.
I'll be ridiculed if the other Scholars learn of this, Wizard. Please find Druj and retrieve the Death Spiral before he causes more trouble!
Retrieve the Death Spiral from Druj before he creates a monster, or else I'll surely be expelled from the Arcanum!
